impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let (Some(first_record_for_the_lane), Some(second_record_for_the_lane)) =
            (self.first.peek(), self.second.peek())
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
